career_ladder.note: Pay scales follow the CPSE Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) 3rd PRC pay structure adopted by Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC). Supervisory technical entrants (Junior Engineer / NE-7) and operations personnel (Station Controller / Train Operator) advance to Section Engineer and into the Executive cadre (Assistant Manager / Grade E-2) via Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE) and Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) assessments.

exam_scheme.note: The selection methodology comprises a multi-stage process: Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of two papers held on the same day at the same examination centre, followed by Psycho Test for train operation and traffic posts (qualifying only), and Document Verification (DV) followed by Pre-appointment Medical Examination in the prescribed Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM) standard (Aye-One/A-1 or Aye-Three/A-3). Candidates must qualify separately in Paper-I and Paper-II.

financial_package.note: DMRC operates on Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) 3rd Pay Revision Commission (PRC) scales. Junior Engineers start at basic pay ₹37,000 (Scale ₹37,000 – ₹1,15,000). While central civil posts run on the 7th CPC CDA matrix, project instructions require applying the fixed benchmark rate of 58% DA as of 2025-07-01 for uniform platform comparability.
financial_package.pay_source_label: DMRC Advt. No. DMRC/HR/RECTT./I/2019 Section B (Post Codes RNE01 to RNE05)
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimate reflects entry basic pay of ₹37,000 in IDA scale ₹37,000–₹1,15,000, 58% standard DA (₹21,460), HRA at 27% (₹9,990) for Delhi-NCR (Class X city), cafeteria perks and allowances (approx. 31.5% to 35% of basic, ₹11,655 to ₹12,950), less statutory EPF (12% of basic + DA), staff welfare, and income tax deductions.
